verses.1: The valleys of Gilboa and the mountains of Lebanon, when the rain of mercy from God does not descend upon them, do not sprout grass for cattle and for beasts.
verses.2: And the mountains of Gilead and the valleys of Elim do not give verdure for the partridge and for the gazelles that are seen, and for the cattle of the wilderness; and shade and shelter and strength fail.
verses.3: And likewise the transgressors and the faithless, who of old were destined for transgression and for error—if the dew of mercy from God does not descend upon them, the dead will not rise, and the adversaries and the oppressors of Cyprus and of Damascus, the arrogant ones.
verses.4: And those who dwell in Segel and Sraya and our adversaries.
verses.5: And those who sing without the Law, and the Atnawyan and the Medon, who trust in their idols and rejoice in them and boast in them with drum and with harp and with flute.
verses.6: And they serve their idols and sing of the work of their hands, those who have not saved themselves, those very ones who will be put to shame on the day of judgment at the resurrection.
verses.7: I perish, and my understanding is confounded; do you think that the dead will not rise?
verses.8: Do not think thus, for it shall not be so, when the horn is sounded at the resurrection of the dead by the mouth of Michael, the chief of the angels.
verses.9: The mountains and the hills will be laid low, and the ravines and the depths will be laid bare, and they will become a level plain.
verses.10: And there will be a resurrection for all flesh.
